title: Hesperetin mitigates IBD-associated bone loss viaenrichment and IDA-driven gut-bone axis crosstalk.
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic inflammatory disorder frequently accompanied by extraintestinal complications such as bone loss, yet effective treatment options remain elusive.
